blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: За ___ (эта минута, acc. pl.) много можно простить.
exercises.why: **минута → минуты** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural минуты. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -ы.  **этот → эти** (acc. pl., agreeing with минуты). «этот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (pl.): эти · этих · этим · эти (inan.) / этих (anim.) · этими · этих.  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Пять ___ (лёт, acc. sg.) назад у меня было отслоение сетчатки.
exercises.prompt: I had retinal detachment five years ago.
exercises.why: **лёт → лет** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. лёт · лёта · лёту · лёт · лётом · лёте; pl. лёты · лётов · лётам · лёты · лётами · лётах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Он пролежал в больнице ___ (весь конец, acc. sg.) поста и Святую.
exercises.why: **конец → конец** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **весь → весь** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with конец). «весь» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (m. sg.): весь · всего · всему · весь (inan.) / всего (anim.) · всем · всём.  Declension: sg. конец · конца · концу · конец · концом · конце; pl. концы · концов · концам · концы · концами · концах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (один день, acc. sg.) Афанасий Иванович решился немного пройтись по саду.
exercises.why: **день → день** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **один → один** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with день). «один» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (m. sg.): один · одного · одному · один (inan.) / одного (anim.) · одним · одном.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Какой и переживет — на ___ (другая зима, acc. sg.) наверное околеет.
exercises.why: **зима → зиму** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  **другой → другую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with зиму). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. русскую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. зима · зимы · зиме · зиму · зимой · зиме; pl. зимы · зим · зимам · зимы · зимами · зимах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Два ___ (месяц, gen. sg.) назад имел удовольствие в «Периодической речи» прочесть.
exercises.why: **месяц → месяца** (gen. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (G. sg. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  Declension: sg. месяц · месяца · месяцу · месяц · месяцем · месяце; pl. месяцы · месяцев · месяцам · месяцы · месяцами · месяцах.  Genitive endings: masculine -а, -я (книга студента, книга учителя); neuter -а, -я (стакан вина, часть здания); feminine -ы, -и (стакан воды, часть семьи, часть тетради). — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
